lamps.steady: SRS malfunction. Have the vehicle inspected by an authorized HYUNDAI dealer.
The driver or front passenger seat belt is not fastened.

lamps.lamp: Parking Brake & Brake Fluid Warning Light
lamps.steady: Parking brake is applied or brake fluid is low. If low, stop safely, check fluid, or tow vehicle.
ABS malfunction. Normal brakes still work. Have vehicle inspected by HYUNDAI dealer.
EPB malfunction. Have the vehicle inspected by an authorized HYUNDAI dealer.
White: Auto Hold active. Green: Vehicle stopped by Auto Hold. Yellow: Malfunction; have inspected by HYUNDAI dealer.
ESC malfunction. Have the vehicle inspected by an authorized HYUNDAI dealer.
lamps.flashing: ESC is operating. Drive slowly and do not accelerate.

lamps.lamp: Electronic Stability Control (ESC) OFF Indicator Light
lamps.steady: ESC system is deactivated.
EPS malfunction. Steering effort may change. Have vehicle inspected by HYUNDAI dealer.
lamps.flashing: May indicate VSM malfunction. Have checked by HYUNDAI dealer.

lamps.steady: Emission control malfunction or catalytic converter damage. Have vehicle inspected by HYUNDAI dealer.
lamps.flashing: Diesel engine injection quantity adjustment error. Have engine control system inspected.

lamps.steady: Alternator or electrical charging system malfunction. Stop safely, check drive belt, and contact HYUNDAI.
Low engine oil pressure. Stop safely immediately, turn off engine, check oil, and add if needed.
Fuel tank is nearly empty. Refuel as soon as possible.

lamps.flashing: Vehicle speed exceeds 120 km/h. Slow down to prevent fast driving.

lamps.steady: Malfunction in systems like TPMS or lamps. Check LCD display for details.

lamps.lamp: Low Tire Pressure / TPMS Warning Light
lamps.steady: One or more tires are significantly under-inflated. Reduce speed and check tire pressure.
lamps.flashing: TPMS malfunction. Have the system inspected by an authorized HYUNDAI dealer.

lamps.steady: Water has accumulated in the fuel filter. Drain water immediately to avoid engine damage.

lamps.lamp: Exhaust System (DPF or LNT) Warning Light
lamps.steady: DPF/LNT malfunction or high soot. Drive over 60 km/h in 2nd+ gear at 1500-2500 RPM for 25 minutes.
lamps.flashing: DPF system may be damaged if blinking for a long time. Have checked.

lamps.steady: Engine is preheating. Start the engine after the light goes off.
lamps.flashing: Engine preheating system malfunction if blinking after engine warms up. Have inspected.

lamps.steady: Key detected. Engine can be started.
lamps.flashing: Immobilizer system malfunction. Have vehicle inspected by HYUNDAI dealer.

lamps.steady: Smart key detected. Engine can start. If lit for 2 seconds and off, key not detected; have inspected.
lamps.flashing: Smart key not in vehicle, battery weak, or system malfunction. Have inspected.

lamps.steady: System malfunction if it stays on instead of blinking. Have checked.
lamps.flashing: Turn signals are operating. Rapid blinking indicates system malfunction.

lamps.steady: LED headlamp malfunction. Have vehicle inspected by HYUNDAI dealer.
lamps.flashing: LED headlamp related part malfunction. Have inspected by HYUNDAI dealer.

lamps.steady: Headlamps are turned on.
High beams are on or headlights are flashed.
Tail lights or headlamps are turned on.
Front fog lights are turned on.
Cruise control system is enabled.
COMFORT drive mode is selected.
ECO drive mode is selected.
SPORT drive mode is selected.
